query: I have a family-based residence permit because of my marriage to a Finnish citizen. We are now divorcing, but I have found a full-time job. Can I stay in Finland, or will my permit be immediately revoked?
expected_answer: If your marriage dissolves, your family-ties residence permit can be cancelled or not extended. However, if you have found a job or have another ground for staying (such as studies), you can apply for a new residence permit based on employment. Your permit is usually not revoked immediately if you file an application on the new grounds before your current permit expires.

query: I am currently an asylum seeker waiting for my decision in Finland. I just got a job offer as a software specialist. Can I apply for a specialist work permit without leaving Finland?
expected_answer: No. Under the legislative changes that entered into force on 31 August 2024, the Finnish Immigration Service will consider your application inadmissible if you apply for your first residence permit based on studies, employment, or trade while residing in Finland. You must leave Finland and apply for your first specialist permit from a Finnish mission abroad.

query: My work permit expired yesterday, and I submitted my extended permit application today in Enter Finland. Am I legally allowed to continue working at my job today?
expected_answer: No. If you only apply for an extended permit after your previous residence permit has already expired, you are not allowed to continue working. Your right to work ends immediately upon the expiry of your old permit, and you cannot legally work again until your new extended permit is granted.

query: My residence permit card expired last week, but I submitted my extension application before it expired. How do I prove to my employer's inspectors at the work site that I still have the right to work?
expected_answer: At the worksite, you can prove your right to work by presenting your old (expired) residence permit card along with the official 'Certificate of a pending application' (vireilläolotodistus) generated by Enter Finland. Because the certificate states that your application was submitted before your old permit expired, your right to work remains active.

query: I am a non-EU citizen. I got a residence card as a family member of an EU citizen. We are now divorcing after living in Finland for 5 years. Can I keep my right of residence and renew my card?
expected_answer: Yes. You can be issued a permanent residence card despite your divorce if you have resided in Finland for at least 5 years, and you have had a valid ground for residence (such as employment, self-employment, or studies with sufficient financial resources) since your marriage was dissolved.

query: I received a negative decision on my asylum application along with a deportation order. I filed an appeal and applied for a prohibition of enforcement with the administrative court. Does my right to work end now?
expected_answer: No. If you appeal the negative decision and the deportation order, and simultaneously file an application for prohibition of enforcement with the administrative court, your right to work continues. Your right to work will remain valid until the administrative court has made a decision on your application for prohibition of enforcement or your appeal.
